info.title: Sharpe API
info.description:
Institutional-grade crypto market data API. Access funding rates, futures, arbitrage opportunities, narratives, ecosystems, and more.

Authentication is supported via two production-safe methods:
1. **Bearer token** in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`
2. **X-API-Key header**: `X-API-Key: sk_live_...`

API keys in query parameters are rejected by default because URLs are commonly stored in logs, browser history, analytics tools, and referrer headers.

These `/v1` endpoints send no CORS headers and must be called from a server: calling them from a browser would expose your API key in page JavaScript. The free, keyless `/api/*` endpoints do allow cross-origin browser requests (https://www.sharpe.ai/docs/free-api).

post.description: Runs a bounded query against a cataloged Sharpe Data Ocean dataset. Accepts only registered dataset IDs, whitelisted fields, filter operators, sort fields, and opaque cursors.

get.description: Returns cross-exchange funding differentials across every funding venue and asset class — crypto plus RWA perps (equity, commodity, FX, index) — ranked by gross annualized funding differential (apr). Pairs never cross asset classes. netFundingRate is the per-period differential at intervalHours (the faster leg's cadence). Spread uses real order books where both legs expose one (spreadSource "book") and reference prices otherwise ("reference"); netApr — the spread- and fee-adjusted figure over a 30-day hold — is only present on book-priced rows. Unknown spread, open interest or volume are null, never zero.

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of venues to compare. Omit for all 33 funding venues (the funding tracker's venue registry).

parameters.name: assetClass
parameters.description: Underlying filter: "all" (default), "crypto", or "rwa" (equity, commodity, FX and index perps).

parameters.name: minOiUsd
parameters.description: Minimum open interest in USD on the smaller leg. Default 0 (no floor). Legs with unknown OI fail a positive floor.

parameters.name: minVolUsd
parameters.description: Minimum 24h perp volume in USD on the smaller leg. Default 0 (no floor). Legs with unknown volume fail a positive floor.

get.description: Returns perpetual funding rates across all supported exchanges. Supports current snapshots, accumulated rates over multiple windows, and per-coin historical rates.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of funding rate data to retrieve.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Base coin ticker (e.g. BTC), or the coin's full name (e.g. `bitcoin`, resolved to BTC). Case-insensitive, one coin per request. Optional filter for type=current and type=accumulated; required when type=history. A value that no perpetual in the funding book has ever settled returns 400 rather than an empty result set; GET /api/funding/coins lists every ticker carried.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days of history to retrieve (type=history only).

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Filter to a single venue. Accepts the slug (e.g. `gate-io`), the display name as returned in the `exchange` field (e.g. `Gate.io`), or the ccxt id. The venue registry is not frozen, so read the `sharpe://exchanges` MCP resource or /api/funding/rates for the current list. An unrecognized value returns 400.

parameters.name: asset_class
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one underlying category. The funding book is not crypto-only. Tokenized equity, commodity, index and FX perps trade on the same venues, so this is unfiltered by default. Applies to type=current and type=accumulated; ignored for type=history. An unrecognized value returns 400.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one collateral convention: `linear` for quote-margined contracts, `inverse` for coin-margined ones. Unfiltered by default. Applies to type=current and type=accumulated; ignored for type=history. An unrecognized value returns 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

get.description: Returns funding and carry for RWA perpetuals across 19 registry-driven venues: CEXs, perp DEXs, Hyperliquid HIP-3 builder markets, and borrow-based venues. Rates are interval-true and mechanism-true: funding_apr annualizes each market's reported settlement interval, while both-sides rollover is reported as borrow_apr_annual and never mixed into funding spreads. The default payload omits venue-internal metadata. type=history returns stored session-tagged settlements (market / after_hours / weekend / holiday) for Hyperliquid and Kraken; type=stats returns trusted, canonical-market carry/spread/OI aggregates and freshness.

get.description: Returns up to 1,000 market-ranked token rows with market cap, nullable FDV and FDV/MCap ratio, volume, nullable price and market-cap changes, circulating supply, ATH and ATL history, preferred chain scope, and observed exchange availability. Stablecoins, wrapped/bridged/pegged and liquid-staking derivative assets, tokenized stocks, assets whose upstream quote is more than 24 hours old (delisted or halted markets that would otherwise report a weeks-old price change as if it were current), and rows below minimum market-cap or volume thresholds are excluded. Ambiguous same-ticker assets do not receive symbol-only exchange attribution. Enrichment coverage is exposed in syncStatus. No wallet signal or proprietary token score is returned.

get.description: Returns how many dollars actually changed hands at funding settlement, and which side paid it. fee_usd = open_interest_usd x rate, priced at the open interest recorded at or before each settlement. `current` is forward-looking and computed live; `1d`/`3d`/`7d` are realised windows from a materialized view. Every window reports both long_paid and short_paid alongside net, and the `totals` block reconciles crypto + rwa === all.

200.description: Funding fee settlement data returned successfully.

FormatParam.name: format
FormatParam.description: Response format. When set to "csv", the response Content-Type is text/csv instead of JSON.

SettlementWindowParam.name: window
SettlementWindowParam.description: Settlement window. `current` is the next (forward-looking) settlement, priced live and labelled `estimated`. `1d`/`3d`/`7d` are realised windows from the funding_fee_settlement matview.

SettlementClassParam.name: class
SettlementClassParam.description: Asset-class scope. `rwa` is every non-crypto `asset_class` (equity, commodity, fx, index). Not a narrower `asset_class` filter -- this plus the per-row `asset_class` field answers every question a second parameter could, and `crypto` + `rwa` always reconciles exactly to `all` in the `totals` block.

SettlementCoinParam.name: coin
SettlementCoinParam.description: Comma-separated base coin tickers, for example BTC,ETH. Unfiltered by default.

SettlementExchangeParam.name: exchange
SettlementExchangeParam.description: Filter to coins settling on a single venue. Accepts the slug, the display name as returned in the `venues[].exchange` field, or the ccxt id. The venue registry is not frozen, so read the `sharpe://exchanges` MCP resource or /api/funding/rates for the current list. An unrecognized value returns 400. Implies the per-venue breakdown internally; the response still omits `venues` unless `expand=venues` is also set.

SettlementSortParam.name: sort
SettlementSortParam.description: Sort field for the selected `window`, optionally prefixed with "-" for descending. Rows with no value for the sort field (an unpriced coin) always sort last, regardless of direction.

SettlementExpandParam.name: expand
SettlementExpandParam.description: Set to `venues` to include each row's per-venue breakdown. Omitted by default to keep the default payload small.

executionStatus.description: Whether the row can be traded on the figures shown. "indicative" means the quote is real but not actionable — the spread came from a reference price rather than a book, or the row's own snapshot is past the freshness SLA. liquidations24hUsd.description: Crypto only; 4-hour Velo buckets, newest still accumulating.

avgRsi.description: Unweighted mean Wilder RSI(14) on daily closes, top 100 crypto perps by open interest.

altcoinSeasonIndex.description: Share of the top 50 by market cap beating BTC over 90 days; excludes stablecoins and wrapped/staked derivatives.

fundingRate.description: Funding fraction normalized to an 8h basis; never assumes the venue interval.

marketCapUsd.description: Null on the preipo and index tabs, where no market cap exists.

liquidations24hUsd.description: Crypto tabs only; null on RWA tabs, where no venue publishes a liquidation feed.

venueCount.description: RWA tabs only; how many venues list the underlying.

SettlementWindowValue.description: net = long_paid - short_paid. Both legs are always present alongside net -- a $0 net can conceal $50M flowing each way. Null means an unpriced/absent contract, never a zero flow.

estimated.description: True on the current window only: priced live from the in-progress rate and latest open interest, not from the matview.

rate_source.description: Where the current window's rate came from. predicted_rate is published by only 5 venues, so `current` (the in-progress rate) is the normal path, not the fallback.

coverage_ratio.description: Realised windows only: how much of the window is covered by priced history. Open interest accrues only forward, so a newly-priced venue's 7d column starts below 1.0.

partial.description: Realised windows only: true when coverage_ratio is below the 0.8 threshold. The numbers still render -- partial means building history, not hidden.

venues.description: Present only when expand=venues is requested.

coins.description: Coins in the selected class, matching the scope of `totals` -- independent of any coin/exchange filter or pagination on this specific request.

total.description: Coins matching this request's coin/exchange filters, before pagination.

totals.description: Same net/long_paid/short_paid shape as a row, scoped to the selected `class`. crypto + rwa === all in every window, for net, long_paid and short_paid.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique request identifier. Include this value when contacting support.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the current rate-limit window resets.

X-Quota-Limit.description: Monthly request quota for the authenticated API key.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a per-minute rate-limit or monthly-quota rejection.

X-Coverage-Start.description: Oldest source timestamp represented in the response. Sent on type=history; absent when the window returned no rows.

X-Requested-Start.description: Start of the window the days parameter asked for, on type=history.

X-Coverage-Complete.description: False when the returned series starts more than 7 days after X-Requested-Start, or returned no rows at all. A short history is a 200 either way, so the shortfall is stated here rather than inferred.

X-Days-Clamped.description: True when days exceeded the 1095-day ceiling and the window was shortened. Always false on /v1, which rejects an out-of-range days value with a 400 instead of clamping it.
